comparison.objective: Rearrange kitchen-rack items so frequently used objects occupy the middle shelf and a rare item does not.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic frequency reasoning and multi-level pick-and-place; no impact tooling or precision fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Items must be on specified shelves, base within 8 mm, tilt under 15 degrees, and still; stacking or leaving items beside the rack earns nothing. Release is not checked.
comparison.reason: Tests accessibility-aware storage planning rather than bimanual impact control, insert preservation, and recovery of all detached tangs.
